sampling.method: op2 dense video_frames: ffmpeg accurate seek, one full-resolution PNG per requested timestamp, 4 frames from 0 to 0.6s every 0.2s

pixel_observations.description: Greyscale echocardiographic sector image (apical four-chamber-like view, depth ticks 5/10/15 on the left, yellow 'V' apex marker, ECG trace with moving red marker at lower left, a number labelled 'HR' and a counter at lower right that changes in every sampled frame (a running timer), greyscale bar at upper right). Four samples 0.2 s apart show the chamber walls and valve echoes changing position; there is no caption/title overlay, no patient name, ID, date or face visible; the running timer is not a date.

author_context.subject: patient

evidence.quote: A transthoracic echocardiogram showing hypokinesia in the mid‐apical segments.
There was severe hypokinesia in the apical and mid‐ventricular segments (Video 1).

author_context.rationale: Video 1 caption and the echocardiography sentence tie the clip to the case patient's transthoracic echo; hypokinesia comes from the text, not the pixels. The figure id ccr371317-fig-0004 is the source-listed owner of ccr371317-vid-0001.mp4.

limitations: Sampled frames only; intervening frames and continuous motion were not viewed.

Original MP4 is only 0.8 s long (1016x708, ~57 fps, no audio track); samples taken every 0.2 s at 0, 0.2, 0.4 and 0.6 s (4 frames; the tool did not emit a sample at 0.8 s). Continuous motion not viewed.
Hypokinesia, EF and segment function are not assessable from sparse still samples and are not confirmed or extended by the pixels.

inspection_provenance.frames_viewed_note: All 4 PNG frames viewed at full resolution.
